items.stimulus: A group wants to test whether the temperature of water affects how quickly sugar dissolves. They use equal amounts of sugar and water in three cups.
items.question: Which factor should the group change deliberately?
items.A: Type of sugar
items.B: Amount of sugar
items.C: Volume of water
items.D: The temperature of the water
items.correct_text: The temperature of the water
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Tama ang iyong pag-interpret sa ebidensiya.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Suriin natin kung aling evidence ang mas sumusuporta sa sagot.
items.explanation: Water temperature is the independent variable dahil ito lang ang sinadyang baguhin. Keeping the other factors constant makes the comparison fair.
items.review_status: Option-length reviewed v2 — SME/pilot required

items.stimulus: A tightly closed container holds air. A learner draws its particles as widely spaced dots moving in different directions.
items.question: Which state of matter is illustrated?
items.A: Solid
items.B: Gas
items.C: Plasma only
items.D: Liquid
items.correct_text: Gas
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Naging maingat ka sa scientific reasoning.
items.feedback_incorrect: Patuloy lang! Ang paliwanag ay makakatulong para mas malinaw ang konsepto.
items.explanation: Ang gas particles ay magkakalayo at malayang gumagalaw sa iba't ibang direksyon. Iyan ang katangiang ipinapakita ng particle diagram.
items.review_status: Option-length reviewed v2 — SME/pilot required

items.focus: States of matter and phase changes
items.stimulus: A covered pot contains boiling water. Vapor rises and touches the cooler underside of the lid, forming droplets.
items.question: Which sequence best describes the changes?
items.A: Liquid vaporizes into gas, then condenses back to liquid.
items.B: Liquid freezes into solid, then the solid melts into liquid.
items.C: Gas deposits into solid, then the solid melts into liquid.
items.D: Solid sublimes into gas, then the gas deposits as solid.
items.correct_text: Liquid vaporizes into gas, then condenses back to liquid.
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Naikonekta mo ang science principle sa real-life example.
items.feedback_incorrect: Salamat sa pagsubok! Gamitin natin ang observation at reasoning upang maunawaan ang sagot.
items.explanation: Sa boiling, water becomes vapor. Kapag lumamig ang vapor sa lid, bumabalik ito sa liquid through condensation.
items.review_status: Options revised v2 — scientific SME review/pilot required

items.stimulus: In a periodic table, sodium and potassium appear in the same vertical column.
items.question: What is the best prediction about them?
items.A: They have identical numbers of electron shells and energy levels.
items.B: They share the same atomic number and nuclear charge.
items.C: They show similar chemical properties because they share a group.
items.D: They represent two names for the same chemical element.
items.correct_text: They show similar chemical properties because they share a group.
items.feedback_correct: Very good! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang tama.
items.feedback_incorrect: Learning opportunity ito! Balikan natin ang main concept at ang tamang application.
items.explanation: Elements in the same group often have similar outer-electron arrangements, kaya magkakahawig ang chemical properties nila.
items.review_status: Options revised v2 — scientific SME review/pilot required

items.stimulus: Two atoms have 6 protons each but contain 6 and 8 neutrons, respectively.
items.question: Which conclusion is correct?
items.A: They are isotopes of carbon with different numbers of neutrons.
items.B: They are different elements because they contain different neutrons.
items.C: Both atoms are positively charged because their nuclei contain protons.
items.D: They have different atomic numbers despite equal proton counts.
items.correct_text: They are isotopes of carbon with different numbers of neutrons.
items.feedback_correct: Excellent! Naipakita mo ang tamang science concept sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Tingnan natin ang scientific clue na makakatulong sa susunod na tanong.
items.explanation: Parehong carbon ang atoms dahil six protons ang bawat isa. Magkaiba lang ang neutrons, kaya isotopes sila ng same element.
items.review_status: Options revised v2 — scientific SME review/pilot required

items.stimulus: A sodium atom loses one electron during a reaction.
items.question: What ion does it form?
items.A: A sodium cation with a positive charge, written Na+.
items.B: A sodium anion with a negative charge, written Na−.
items.C: A neutral sodium atom with no overall electric charge.
items.D: A sodium molecule containing two bonded sodium atoms.
items.correct_text: A sodium cation with a positive charge, written Na+.
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Tama ang iyong pag-interpret sa ebidensiya.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Suriin natin kung aling evidence ang mas sumusuporta sa sagot.
items.explanation: Kapag nawalan ng electron ang atom, mas maraming positive charges kaysa negative charges. Kaya nagiging Na+ ang sodium ion.
items.review_status: Options revised v2 — scientific SME review/pilot required

items.stimulus: A student compares H2O and NaCl.
items.question: Which statement correctly distinguishes their bonding?
items.A: Both compounds form through attraction among free-moving metallic electrons.
items.B: Water shares electrons covalently; sodium chloride contains attracting ions.
items.C: Water forms ionic bonds because hydrogen always transfers electrons.
items.D: Sodium chloride uses covalent bonds because it has two elements.
items.correct_text: Water shares electrons covalently; sodium chloride contains attracting ions.
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Naging maingat ka sa scientific reasoning.
items.feedback_incorrect: Patuloy lang! Ang paliwanag ay makakatulong para mas malinaw ang konsepto.
items.explanation: Sa H2O, sharing of electrons ang nag-uugnay sa atoms; sa NaCl, attraction between ions ang bonding. Mahalaga ang pagkakaibang ito sa properties ng substances.

items.question: What does the remaining solid most likely indicate?

items.feedback_correct: Very good! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang tama.
items.feedback_incorrect: Learning opportunity ito! Balikan natin ang main concept at ang tamang application.
items.explanation: Kapag may natitirang undissolved salt sa equilibrium, maaaring saturated na ang solution. May limit ang amount of solute na matutunaw sa given conditions.

items.A: Rusting
items.B: Neutralization
items.C: Photosynthesis
items.D: Evaporation
items.correct_text: Photosynthesis
items.feedback_correct: Well done! Tama ang iyong pag-interpret sa ebidensiya.
items.feedback_incorrect: Nice try! Suriin natin kung aling evidence ang mas sumusuporta sa sagot.
items.explanation: Photosynthesis uses light energy to make chemical energy in sugars. Mahalaga ito sa plants at sa food webs.

items.question: Which sequence correctly moves from simpler to more complex biological organization?

items.B: Tissue → organism → cell → organ system → organ
items.C: Organism → cell → tissue → organ → organ system
items.D: Cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism
items.correct_text: Cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Naging maingat ka sa scientific reasoning.
items.feedback_incorrect: Patuloy lang! Ang paliwanag ay makakatulong para mas malinaw ang konsepto.

items.question: Why is it classified as unicellular?
items.A: The organism depends on several tissues to carry out life functions.
items.B: One cell carries out the organism's essential life processes.
items.C: Its body contains many specialized organs working together.
items.D: The organism cannot perform normal biological processes independently.
items.correct_text: One cell carries out the organism's essential life processes.
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Naikonekta mo ang science principle sa real-life example.
items.feedback_incorrect: Salamat sa pagsubok! Gamitin natin ang observation at reasoning upang maunawaan ang sagot.
items.explanation: Unicellular means isang cell lang ang buong organism. Kaya nitong isagawa ang necessary life processes.

items.question: What directly carries the hereditary instructions from parents to offspring?

items.B: Heat stored in the body carries the inherited genetic instructions.
items.C: Water in the cytoplasm carries inherited traits without DNA.
items.D: Air passing through the lungs carries hereditary instructions.

items.feedback_correct: Very good! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang tama.
items.feedback_incorrect: Learning opportunity ito! Balikan natin ang main concept at ang tamang application.

items.D: Liver

items.B: Maintenance of stable internal conditions, or homeostasis
items.C: Conversion of sunlight into sugars by body cells
items.D: Production of oxygen from carbon dioxide in lungs

items.B: Xylem
items.C: Chlorophyll
items.D: Phloem
items.correct_text: Xylem
items.feedback_correct: Great job! Naging maingat ka sa scientific reasoning.
items.feedback_incorrect: Patuloy lang! Ang paliwanag ay makakatulong para mas malinaw ang konsepto.

items.stimulus: In a simple genetic model, tall pea plants (T) are dominant over short plants (t). A plant has genotype Tt.
items.question: What is its phenotype?
items.A: The plant will be short because it has a recessive allele.
items.B: Its height cannot be predicted without another genetic cross.
items.C: The plant will be tall because the T allele is dominant.
items.D: The plant will show both tall and short traits simultaneously.
items.correct_text: The plant will be tall because the T allele is dominant.
items.feedback_correct: Correct! Naikonekta mo ang science principle sa real-life example.
items.feedback_incorrect: Salamat sa pagsubok! Gamitin natin ang observation at reasoning upang maunawaan ang sagot.
items.explanation: Kung T is dominant, ang heterozygous Tt ay nagpapakita ng tall phenotype. Hindi kailangan ng dalawang T copies para lumitaw ang dominant trait.
items.review_status: Options revised v2 — scientific SME review/pilot required

items.question: Which term describes a change in the DNA sequence that ultraviolet exposure may cause?
items.A: DNA repair after exposure to damaging ultraviolet radiation
items.B: Normal genetic recombination between two reproductive cells
items.C: A mutation affecting the DNA sequence of a skin cell
items.D: Cell differentiation that does not change a cell's DNA
items.correct_text: A mutation affecting the DNA sequence of a skin cell
items.feedback_correct: Very good! Nasuri mo ang impormasyon nang tama.
items.feedback_incorrect: Learning opportunity ito! Balikan natin ang main concept at ang tamang application.
items.explanation: Mutation ang pagbabago sa DNA sequence. UV radiation is one factor that can cause such changes.
items.review_status: Science precision and option revision v2 — SME/pilot required

items.B: Energy passes unchanged from producers to top-level predators.
items.C: Organisms use energy for life processes and release heat.
items.D: Consumers destroy all the energy originally captured by producers.
items.correct_text: Organisms use energy for life processes and release heat.
items.feedback_correct: Excellent! Naipakita mo ang tamang science concept sa sitwasyon.
items.feedback_incorrect: Good effort! Tingnan natin ang scientific clue na makakatulong sa susunod na tanong.
items.explanation: Habang lumilipat ang energy sa food chain, malaking bahagi nito ay ginagamit for life processes at nailalabas bilang heat. Kaya mas kaunti ang energy sa higher trophic levels.

items.feedback_incorrect: Learning opportunity ito! Balikan natin ang main concept at ang tamang application.

items.question: What is its average acceleration?

items.C: 10 m/s²
